scope: 19 structural RepRel candidates; per-row discriminator is a hypothesis for verification, not a confirmed identity key
source: G3-2e-E native model and G3-2e-F focal SHACL shapes

rows.candidate_distinctness_basis_to_verify: reference product, alternative product, decision context and effective period
rows.positive_witness: Two relator instances link the same mediated individuals but differ in a documented scope or non-overlapping validity interval; admit only if the domain allows repeat events.
rows.rejecting_witness: Two relator instances link the same mediated individuals and have indistinguishable scope and overlapping time; reject only if a current-instance uniqueness rule is scientifically approved.
rows.focal_shacl_duplicate_fixture: ACCEPTED; shape imposes no participant-tuple uniqueness
rows.recommended_disposition: Do not force global upper 1. Determine relator identity, scope and concurrent uniqueness from source/author evidence before adding a scoped SHACL/OCL rule.
